description: This source file defines the Opencart Admin Controller class 'Fixer' for managing currency exchange rates via the Fixer API. It includes methods for displaying the currency configuration page, saving API credentials and settings, and updating currency rates based on the external API.

classes.name: Fixer
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency exchange rates through the Fixer.io API within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the currency fixer configuration page, including current API settings and currency data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the API credentials and settings, and updates currency rates using the Fixer.io API.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches exchange rates from Fixer.io API and updates the local currency values in the database.
